name: workflow-en
description: Doc-driven multi-agent development workflow (Conductor/Executor/Reviewer three tiers): /scaffold lays down CLAUDE.md + an eight-doc set in place; /whats-next reads the docs and tells you what to do next; sop-generate generates a screenshot-backed business SOP for an already deployed web app; new sessions auto-recognize "wants to build a new project" and silently scaffold it (auto-scaffold, opt-out available)
